title: Editorial Brief
description: Structured brief defining the full scope, audience, constraints, and success criteria for a writing task. Required input for the outline workflow.

title.description: Working title of the document to be produced

task_type.description: Document category, used to select default style pack and workflow

knowledge_level.description: Assumed knowledge level of the primary reader

purpose.description: What this document accomplishes for the reader — not what it covers, but what it does

description.description: One or two sentences describing the overall scope

in_scope.description: Explicit list of topics, sections, or content items included in this task

out_of_scope.description: Explicit list of topics or content that must not be included

style_pack.description: Identifier of the style pack to apply (e.g. 'general-writing', 'lore-player-facing')

tone.description: Specific tone instructions beyond the style pack defaults

success_criteria.description: Enumerated criteria for what a successful output looks like — each item must be checkable, not vague

format.description: Required output format (e.g. 'markdown', 'docx', 'plain prose without headers')

required_sections.description: Section titles or types that must be present in the output

forbidden_content.description: Content, topics, or approaches explicitly prohibited

other.description: Additional constraints not covered by other fields

source_material.description: List of available source documents, file paths, or guide IDs

canon_references.description: Canon guide IDs relevant to this brief — used by domain QA and section drafters

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions at brief time — non-blocking items are documented here; blocking items must be resolved before brief approval

created_by.description: Agent ID that created this brief

run_id.description: Cache run ID this brief belongs to — used for session traceability
